_comment: Lookup for retargeting content authored against the GenHuman rig onto the Daniel rig (derived from GenHuman and renamed 2026-07-30). tokenRules is the authoritative, lossless map: applying the rules in order reproduces every one of the 920 node renames, including the ~600 mechanical Daniel_rig_deformLayer_hrc_* utility nodes not listed individually below. The named maps are landmarks for humans and for code that needs specific nodes.

tokenRules.note: Must run first. The layer already carried the character name, so a literal GH->Daniel swap would have produced Daniel_Daniel_Geo.
Typo fix, not a rig rename. Also corrects hands_mwshShape / hands_mwshShapeOrig.
Run last. Covers the top node, all rig groups, meta/set nodes, the namespace and the Hive hName/zooHiveId string attrs.

pathPrefixes._comment: Longest-prefix-first. Outfitter stores joint plugs as DAG paths (core/registry.py: src). These two rules retarget any stored GenHuman path.

unchanged._comment: Verified against the source file - these need NO retargeting, which is what makes an old GenHuman asset reusable on Daniel.
unchanged.exportSkeletonJoints: All 369 export-skeleton joints keep their names (root, pelvis, spine_01 ... ). Only the 7 namespaced IK joints moved, and only by namespace: GenHuman_rig:ik_hand_l -> Daniel_rig:ik_hand_l.
unchanged.controlNames: Animation controls are unprefixed (god_m_godnode_anim, arm_l_*, leg_r_* ...) and are unchanged.
unchanged.meshGroup: Mesh_GRP keeps its name; only its internal nesting changed (see structuralChanges).
unchanged.skinSetJointNames: The cloth_* joint lists in data/rigs/genhuman.json apply unchanged to Daniel.

structuralChanges.detail: The 6 garment meshes were parented directly under Mesh_GRP; the stray intermediate group Mesh_GRP_mesh was deleted. It had identity transforms (pivot values only), so geometry did not move.
Mesh_GRP_mesh was the sole member of the geo display layer. That connection moved to Mesh_GRP, which covers the identical subtree: connectAttr Daniel_Geo.di -> Mesh_GRP.do.
No GenHuman body mesh was present to delete; Mesh_GRP already contained only the 6 new meshes.

outfitterNotes._comment: Consequences for the Outfitter tool - see scripts/outfitter/config.py and data/rigs/genhuman.json.
outfitterNotes.rigDetection: RIG_MARKERS / genhuman.json markers are ['god_m_godnode_anim', 'GenHuman_Joint_GRP', 'GenHuman']. Two of the three no longer match, so this scene will NOT be detected as genhuman. Register a Daniel profile via the Publish tab's 'Register rig' action.
outfitterNotes.legacyAssets: Assets published with no rigId still read as genhuman (core/asset.py). Use pathPrefixes above to retarget their stored joint plugs onto Daniel.
